name: Villagers Have Last Names
description: Babies born in the village and the village's founders get a last name after their first name, from the game's own list of 50 last names (Akikai, Alosaka, Awanata ... Wikimak) -- a list the game has always carried but never used, and the one Virtual Villagers 6 and 7 later used for villagers' last names. A baby takes its father's or its mother's last name by the rule chosen in Repair Saves & Logs (Last names come from: from the father, from the mother, 50:50, or a random one of the last names the village has ever used); without a rule recorded, a baby takes its father's last name (the village's default is from the father). A villager can also have a rule of their own for their children (Each villager's own rule): from the father, from the mother, 50:50, a random last name from the list, which gives each child -- twins and triplets too -- its own random draw from the game's list, every name equally likely, or a random one of the village's existing last names. A villager's own rule always beats the village's; when both parents have one and they disagree, a coin toss for each child picks whose. A villager who arrives without a last name -- an island event's newcomer, a barrel's babies, a copy, a Story / Cheat Upgrades' or Custom Island Event's villager -- gets a random one from the game's list as they arrive, which may or may not be a name the village already has; one who arrives with a last name keeps it. Only villagers named from now on get one: villagers who already have names keep them. The last name is part of the name the game stores, so it shows wherever the name does and stays in the save even if this patch is later removed. **Needs no other patch.**
behavior_changes: A baby born in the village from now on (a mother's delivery: the first child, a twin or a triplet) and a new village's founders are called "<first name> <last name>": the first name is the game's own pick, and the last name is name number <family - 1> of the game's unused third list (0X4AA930), read from the running executable.

A villager the game creates any other way -- brought by an island event, a barrel, a copy, a cheat, the Origins page, the Story / Cheat Upgrades or a Custom Island Event -- is called "<first name> <last name>" with a last name drawn at random from the same list, every name that fits equally likely (the draw "Random last name from the list" makes), shared with the village or not; a name with more than one word is kept as it is, and a name an event writes afterwards replaces it. The companion tells a birth, a founder or an arrival by the callers' return addresses on the stack, at fixed places.

The records the game makes and takes away again get none: the seeding a load overwrites, The Lost Children's Strange Request stranger, The Tree of Life's ghosts and adoption stand-in, New Believers' founder candidate's stand-in and Reanimate's stand-in.
A baby or founder whose family is outside 1-50 gets no last name.

At a birth, the rule recorded by Repair Saves & Logs decides the last name (VvfpRuleLastName2): the father's, the mother's, either at random (50:50), or -- a parent's own rule "Random last name from the list" -- a name drawn at random from the game's list, or -- "Random from the existing Village Names", the village's rule or a parent's own -- one of the last names the village has ever used (the record's "used" lines, the villagers in the game at the birth, VvfpRuleLastName3, and the parents'; the game's list when there are none); every random draw is a fresh, unbiased one for each child. Each such birth adds the names it saw that the record lacks as "used" lines (only adding, through a temporary file, never for a slot it cannot tell), so a name stays ever used after its last bearer is gone.
A parent's own rule always beats the village's; parents whose own rules disagree: a fresh coin toss for each child picks the father's or the mother's.
The whole name always fits the game's own name field: the longest pairing is far below its 23 characters.

The choose-your-founders screen ("Select 5 villagers") draws a candidate's name that is wider than its room (140 pixels: the names' centres are 148 apart) in two or more lines broken at its spaces, each centred under the villager with the game's own draw, font and colour, so long "<first name> <last name>" names no longer run into each other; the whole name is shown, never cut. A name that fits is drawn as before.
explicit_non_changes: No executable byte is patched: the companion detours the naming routine's first instruction at run time and the founders screen's name call (0x43B80A, on its own), after verifying it, the routine's push of the list and the creators' calls to it, and changes nothing if any differs.
Villagers who already have names keep them; nothing is renamed when a village is loaded.
The first names, sexes, looks and families are the game's own; the save format is unchanged.
evidence_status: static exact-build verification of the naming routines, their callers and the unused list in each executable; runtime/player confirmation pending

runtime_detours.routine: the villager naming routine (thiscall villager, family)
the choose-your-founders screen's name draw (call of the centred draw 0x409BE0): a name wider than its room is drawn in lines that fit
